name: Mike Gushansky
bio1: I like analog things. I grew up playing the piano, then collecting records and djing, and shooting film. I like how it feels to get lost exploring analog equipment, to work earnestly sometimes  with no particular intent, towards mastering variables that can’t be easily mastered or perceived.
bio2: Music discovery, djing and producing spaces to experience music is what I spend a lot of my time thinking about and doing. I picked up my first turntables from Turntable Lab in Fairfax after class in 2007 and haven't stopped collecting and performing since. It’s been 20 years of djing and producing events including undergrounds in the forest of Santa Cruz, a 6 year residency at AYLI SF, co-founding the LA underground series Redline and playing around the world including Asia, North America South America and Europe. Working on a new project, and thrilled to be sharing more here soon.
bio3: I fell into my first film camera at a flea market in Santa Cruz in 2008. I spent $20 on a heavily used and barely functional canon rebel on the street and that was it, I was hooked .I like to capture real life as it happens, whether its my favorite people, sunsets, new horizons or the harshness of living on the street. I shoot 35 and 120mm on my F3 and 500cm.  I take my cameras everywhere, though I admittedly don’t do a great job of sharing my life and adventures with you all.
bio4: I love to travel and perform. Message me if you want to get in touch. Hope you enjoy sounds and pixels.
